create_streaming_module: create a PyTorch module inheriting from StreamingModule to manage streaming state for audio processing
use_streaming_context_manager: use the StreamingModule streaming context manager to enter and exit streaming mode with automatic state reset
get_and_set_streaming_state: get and set the streaming state dictionary across all submodules using get_streaming_state and set_streaming_state
reset_streaming_state: reset the streaming state for all StreamingModule submodules by calling reset_streaming on the parent module
flush_streaming_sequential: flush remaining buffered outputs through a StreamingSequential pipeline by calling flush with an optional tensor
